messages:
Priya: Heads-up 10: security just flagged a GDPR-data residency cert gap. Compliance says we can't onboard EU pilot seats for v1 until certified. This affects milestone Apr-15. Need a cut/plan by EOD.
Tomas: Oof. Is that a hard blocker or just for EU-specific tenants?
Hannah: It's primarily EU tenants, but customers expect it in the pilot region. If we ship MVP without it, we lose credibility for the EU pilot list.
Leo: Sales: several pilots in EMEA are on the fence. They said timeline is the dealbreaker. Can we promise a compensating control?
Ravi: Engineering estimate: the residency work + encryption-at-rest tweaks and audit surfaces is ~3 weeks if we re-prioritize infra sprint.
Priya: Two choices: 1) delay Apr milestone by 3 weeks and keep current feature set, or 2) keep Apr date but cut region-sensitive features (EU pilot, per-tenant model pinning, extended audit logs) to ship on time globally.
Tomas: Cutting per-tenant model pinning is rough for platform teams, but we can roll it in v1. The core inference APIs and caching stay.
Hannah: From CS: if we drop EU pilot support for MVP we should offer a "localized pilot" program with concierge onboarding + SLA credit to keep customers engaged.
Leo: Acceptable if we get firm timeline for the residency cert within 3 weeks and a signed pilot LOI from the customers.
Priya: Proposed cutlist (fast-ship): drop per-tenant model pinning, extended audit retention (90d -> 30d), EU-console locale features; keep model catalog, embeddings caching, promptstore. Defer residency-wide cert work to v1 but provide concierge EU pilot option.
Tomas: Add technical note: need a temporary routing policy so EU traffic can be pinned to compliant regions when available. That will be a small feature (2 days).
Ravi: Ops caveat: concierge EU pilots require manual setup + docs. We need runbook and a small Dedicated slot per pilot. Ops can do up to 2 manual pilots in parallel.
Priya: Decision avenue: prefer to keep ship date and do concierge pilots. This minimizes slip but adds manual work. We should record the trade in milestone tracker.
Hannah: I'll draft the concierge onboarding doc and pilot acceptance template. Also will prepare customer comms for the EU pilots.
Leo: I'll contact the top 3 EU prospects and offer the concierge route with SLA credit; will report back by COB tomorrow.
Tomas: For release safety, propose rollback policy snippet:
```
rollback-policy: 
- release tag: v2026-04-15-mvp
- canary: 10% traffic for 24h -> 50% for 12h -> full
- auto-rollback: triggered on error-rate >2% or latency p99 > 2s
- manual rollback: Ops runbook + database migration revert steps
```
Priya: Good. Add a blocking flag for residency cert in the milestone metadata and mark EU pilot as "concierge-only" for MVP.
Ravi: I'll prep the Ops runbook, note Dedicated slot needs, and estimate cost for the 2 manual pilots.
Priya: Action items:
- Tomas: implement short routing pin for EU (2d) and add the rollback checks to CI (tomorrow)
- Ravi: ops runbook + pilot cost estimate (48h)
- Hannah: concierge onboarding + customer messaging (24h)
- Leo: customer outreach + LOIs (48h)
- Priya: update milestone tracker and notify stakeholders of cut decision (EOD)
ReleaseBot: release note draft created: releases/milestones/2026-04-15/mvp-cutlist.md -> reviewers @product @eng @ops
Tomas: Also adding a perf-eval to compare p99 with/without extended audit retention so Finance can see delta.
Priya: Nice. Meeting adjourned. We'll reconvene after LOIs or if ops cost is prohibitive.
Hannah: Posting the concierge template in #customer-success once ready.
Leo: Thanks all 10
Priya: Recording: MVP ships Apr-15 with cuts: no per-tenant pinning, reduced audit retention, EU pilot concierge only; residency cert moves to v1. Milestone tracker updated.
